explanation: Searched Mathlib/Topology/DiscreteQuotient.lean: its only injectivity lemmas are toSetoid_injective, proj_bot_injective and finsetClopens_inj. None of its map lemmas (map_proj, map_comp_proj, map_comp, ofLE_map, ...) states that DiscreteQuotient.map along a comap quotient (B.comap f → B) is injective. The Profinite and LightProfinite category files have nothing similar. At the setoid level, the closest statements are Setoid.comapQuotientEquiv (Quotient (comap f r) ≃ range (mk ∘ f)) and Setoid.ker_lift_injective combined with Setoid.comap_eq. Using either would mean showing that the underlying map matches DiscreteQuotient.map, or rewriting along comap_eq, which is a proved equality and does not hold by unfolding. That is more than routine glue.
